summary: Master hospitality technology, PMS integration, and digital innovation. Lead hotel digital transformation and optimize guest experiences. Enroll today.
lede: Hospitality technology training helps hotel IT, operations, and revenue professionals connect digital systems with guest and operational needs. It addresses the practical work of selecting and integrating hotel systems while improving guest-facing processes. Participants practice assessing PMS architecture and interoperability, mapping digital guest journeys, evaluating vendors, and planning phased technology changes.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for the selection, implementation, and management of digital solutions within the hospitality and tourism sectors.
modules: Cybersecurity and Data Privacy in Hospitality
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in hospitality management, hotel IT, or revenue operations. A basic understanding of hotel operational workflows (front office, reservations, or F&B) is required. No advanced programming knowledge is necessary, but familiarity with standard office productivity tools and basic data analysis is expected.
